_comment: Converted from JabRef's Crowdin project glossary (TBX export supplied by @Siedlerchr on JabRef/jabref#16176, 2026-07-29). 'ru' holds settled EN->RU mappings supplied to both model passes as preferred lemmas. '_quarantine_ru' documents mappings that are deliberately excluded until a Russian reviewer resolves the recorded ambiguity or typo. Terms that must never be translated live in brand_technical_glossary in config.yaml.
_source: JabRef's Glossary.tbx (Crowdin, TBX-Basic), 83 termEntries, 31 with a Russian equivalent
_review_status: The 23 active mappings reproduce the supplied export, not a newly approved glossary. Edit ru after native review; keep the eight quarantined mappings excluded until their stated issues are resolved. No live Crowdin glossary synchronization is configured.

citation.hold_reason: RU "цитата" = a quotation. Many backlog strings use the bibliometric sense (Total Citations, citation count, Refetch citations) where "цитата" is wrong. 17 backlog strings affected — needs InAnYan to split the senses.

Cite As You Write.hold_reason: definition marked "К обсуждению" (= to be discussed) — not a settled term.

consistency check.hold_reason: see "integrity check" — same RU term for two distinct English terms.

importer.hold_reason: RU value has a typo: "средство иморта" (should be "импорта"). Definition is also marked "К обсуждению" (= to be discussed), so not settled.

integrity check.hold_reason: collides with "consistency check" — both pinned to "проверка согласованности". JabRef has both "Checking consistency of '%0'" and "Checking integrity of '%0'"; enforcing both makes them identical in the UI.

master's thesis.hold_reason: RU value has a typo: "магистерская дисертация" (should be "диссертация").

сhunk.hold_reason: source term begins with CYRILLIC ES (U+0441), not Latin c — can never match English source. Broken in Crowdin too.

сitation style.hold_reason: source term begins with CYRILLIC ES (U+0441), not Latin c — can never match English source. Also its RU value begins with a LATIN c. Broken in Crowdin too.
